name: Visible Privacy
description: Cookie-consent management platform: banners, automated GDPR & CCPA consent tracking, Google Consent Mode v2 compatibility, and an open-source enterprise edition (company-stated). Pricing: Essential €7/mo (1 domain, 1,000 consent interactions), Pro €15/mo (3 domains, 10,000 interactions), Max €33, Elite €55, Enterprise contact sales. It's priced per interaction rather than per page view, plus an agency partner and reseller program (founder-stated + homepage). Founded Aug 2024, Spain. 77 subscriptions.

mentions.evidence: MRR $1,792 · 77 active subscriptions Last 30 days $1,494 (+4.4%) · last 3 months $10,488 · last 6 months $15,650 Last 12 months $24,176 · all-time $33,394 Monthly: ~$0.8–2.6k (Nov 2025 → Jul 2026) → $6,755 (Aug, one-off spike, probably annual/enterprise deals; not stated) → $1,437 (Sep); Oct MTD $769. Revenue synced 20 October 2026 ~04:19 Warsaw.
mentions.indieAngle: The CMP market is crowded (Cookiebot, CookieYes), so the angle is distribution. Sell a Polish-language "RODO pakiet" (consent banner + privacy policy + cookie scan) to web agencies and WordPress freelancers as white-label, priced per client site.

whyItPrints: It's legally required on every EU website, and Google Consent Mode v2 made it a hard dependency for anyone running Google Ads. Small sites pay €7–15 a month forever and never think about it again, and agencies resell it.
